camel_example: aliyun eiam CreateCustomField --region cn-hangzhou --EntityType user --FieldDisplayName name_001 --FieldDataType string --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --FieldDisplayType input --FieldName field_001
kebab_example: aliyun eiam create-custom-field --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --entity-type user --field-name field_001 --field-display-name name_001 --field-display-type input --field-data-type string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomField

parameters.help_en:
The entity to which the field belongs. Valid values:
user: account
parameters.help_zh:
字段归属实体，取值可选范围：
user：账户
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en:
The field identifier.
Maximum length: 40 characters. The value can contain lowercase letters and underscores, and cannot start with an underscore
parameters.help_zh:
字段标识名。
最大长度限制为40，内容格式可包含英文小写字母和下划线，不能以下划线开头
parameters.name: field_name

parameters.help_en:
The field display name.
Maximum length: 64 characters
parameters.help_zh:
字段展示名。
最大长度限制为64
parameters.name: field_display_name

parameters.help_en:
The field display type. Valid values:
input: text input box. Supported data types: string and number.
select: drop-down list. Supported data types: string and boolean.
checkbox: multi-select box. Supported data types: string
parameters.help_zh:
字段展示类型，取值可选范围：
input：文本输入框。对应可选数据类型：string、number
select：下拉框。对应可选数据类型：string、boolean
checkbox：多选框。对应可选数据类型：string
parameters.name: field_display_type

parameters.help_en:
The data type of the field. Valid values:
string: string.
number: number. Maximum length: 32 characters. Positive integers and decimals are supported.
boolean: Boolean
parameters.help_zh:
字段数据类型，取值可选范围：
string：字符串。
number：数字，最大长度限制32，支持正整数和小数。
boolean：布尔
parameters.name: field_data_type

parameters.help_en:
The default value of the field.
If configuration items exist for the type, the default value must be one of the configuration items and must be in the enabled state. Maximum length: 1024 characters
parameters.help_zh:
字段默认值。
若类型存在配置项，则默认值必须在配置项中且处于启用状态，最大长度限制为1024
parameters.name: default_value

fields.help_en:
The display name of the configuration item.
Maximum length: 128 characters
fields.help_zh:
配置项展示名。
最大长度限制为128
fields.name: display_name

fields.help_en:
The status of the configuration item. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled.

If a configuration item is disabled, it cannot be used when creating or updating entity field values
fields.help_zh:
配置项状态，取值可选范围：
enabled：启用。
disabled：禁用。

配置项禁用，在创建和更新实体字段值时，该配置项不可用
fields.name: status

fields.help_en:
The display value of the configuration item.
Maximum length: 64 characters
fields.help_zh:
配置项展示值。
最大长度限制为64
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The list of field configuration items. Maximum number of items: 100
fields.help_zh: 字段配置项列表。列表项最大限制数100
fields.name: items

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the field value is unique.
If this parameter is set to true, the field value must be unique within the corresponding entity type and cannot be duplicated
parameters.help_zh:
字段值是否唯一。
设置为true，则该字段的值在对应实体类型中唯一存在，不可重复
parameters.name: unique

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the field.
If this parameter is set to true, the data value is encrypted at the storage layer
parameters.help_zh:
是否加密。
设置为true，则底层会对数据值进行加密存储
parameters.name: encrypted

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the field is required
parameters.name: required

parameters.help_en:
The field permission on the portal side. Valid values:
hide: Not visible on the portal side.
read_only: Visible on the portal side but cannot be edited or updated.
read_write: Visible and editable on the portal side
parameters.help_zh:
portal侧字段权限，取值可选范围：
hide：portal侧不可见。
read_only：portal侧可见，不能编辑更新。
read_write：portal侧可见且可编辑更新
parameters.name: user_permission

parameters.help_en:
The field description.
Maximum length: 512 characters
parameters.help_zh:
字段描述。
长度限制512
parameters.name: description
